description: This Java class `JsonQuery` provides an immutable representation of a JSON-based query, wrapping JSON payloads for parsing and extracting parameters with convenience methods. It includes functions for detecting differences in parameter values, handling various data types, and interaction with JSON helper utilities.

classes.name: JsonQuery
classes.description: An immutable class representing a JSON query, providing methods to parse, verify, and extract parameter values of various types, as well as detect differences between current and previous parameter states for update scenarios.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Static factory method to create a JsonQuery instance from JSON command string, parsed JSON element, and helper.

methods.name: json
methods.description: Returns the JSON command string.

methods.name: parsedJson
methods.description: Returns the parsed JSON element.

methods.name: differenceExists
methods.description: Overloaded methods to determine if there is a difference between two parameter values of various types (LocalDate, String, String arrays, Number, BigDecimal, Boolean).

methods.name: parameterExists
methods.description: Checks whether a specific parameter exists in the JSON.

methods.name: hasParameter
methods.description: Alias for parameterExists, indicating whether the parameter is present.

methods.name: dateFormat
methods.description: Retrieves the 'dateFormat' string parameter.

methods.name: locale
methods.description: Retrieves the 'locale' string parameter.

methods.name: mapValueOfParameterNamed
methods.description: Extracts a map of string keys to boolean values from a parameter.

methods.name: isChangeInLongParameterNamed
methods.description: Determines if a Long parameter value has changed compared to an existing value.

methods.name: longValueOfParameterNamed
methods.description: Retrieves a Long value of the specified parameter.

methods.name: isChangeInLocalDateParameterNamed
methods.description: Checks if a LocalDate parameter value has changed.

methods.name: localDateValueOfParameterNamed
methods.description: Retrieves a LocalDate value of a parameter.

methods.name: isChangeInStringParameterNamed
methods.description: Checks if a String parameter value has changed.

methods.name: stringValueOfParameterNamed
methods.description: Retrieves a String value of a parameter.

methods.name: isChangeInBigDecimalParameterNamed
methods.description: Checks if a BigDecimal parameter value has changed.

methods.name: bigDecimalValueOfParameterNamed
methods.description: Retrieves a BigDecimal value of a parameter.

methods.name: isChangeInIntegerParameterNamed
methods.description: Checks if an Integer parameter value has changed.

methods.name: integerValueOfParameterNamed
methods.description: Retrieves an Integer value of a parameter.

methods.name: isChangeInBooleanParameterNamed
methods.description: Checks if a Boolean parameter value has changed.

methods.name: booleanObjectValueOfParameterNamed
methods.description: Retrieves a Boolean object (nullable) for a parameter.

methods.name: booleanPrimitiveValueOfParameterNamed
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean primitive, defaulting to false if null.

methods.name: isChangeInArrayParameterNamed
methods.description: Checks if an array parameter (string array) has changed.

methods.name: arrayValueOfParameterNamed
methods.description: Retrieves an array of strings for a parameter.

methods.name: isChangeInPasswordParameterNamed
methods.description: Checks if a password parameter value has changed, comparing encoded values.

methods.name: passwordValueOfParameterNamed
methods.description: Encodes a password parameter value using a password encoder.
